sources.title: Liberia Immigration Service Service Delivery Charter
sources.officialityEvidence: The Liberia Immigration Service publishes this January 2025 Service Delivery Charter on its lis.gov.lr domain; it says the Charter governs all public-facing LIS services.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Processing of VISA ON ARRIVAL (Non-African and Non ECOWAS African Citizens).

sources.title: Liberia Immigration Service Visa on Arrival application portal
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Visa on Arrival portal is hosted on the Liberia Immigration Service lis.gov.lr subdomain and identifies LIS as the immigration authority.
sources.supportingExcerpt: At the designated Visa on Arrival counter at the airport in Liberia, present your printed confirmation letter with QR code.

sources.title: Discover Liberia: entry and visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Discover Liberia visitor portal identifies itself as powered by the Liberia National Tourism Authority and is hosted on its lnta.gov.lr subdomain.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of ECOWAS member states may enter without a visa.

sources.title: ECOWAS current Member States
sources.publisher: Economic Community of West African States Commission
sources.officialityEvidence: The ECOWAS Commission publishes this live membership page and identifies itself as the site manager in its footer.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Benin, Cabo Verde, Côte d’Ivoire, Ghana, Guinea, Guinea Bissau, Liberia, Nigeria, Senegal, Sierra Leone, The Gambia, Togo.

sources.title: ECOWAS press statement on AES withdrawal
sources.publisher: Economic Community of West African States Commission
sources.officialityEvidence: The ECOWAS Commission publishes this 30 January 2025 statement, which directs authorities in and outside ECOWAS member States on the continuing treatment of Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger citizens.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Permettre aux citoyens des pays concernés de continuer à jouir, jusqu’à nouvel ordre, du droit de circulation, de résidence et d’établissement sans visa.

policies.title: Liberia: ECOWAS and continuing AES ordinary passports visa-free
policies.summary: Liberia’s National Tourism Authority states that ECOWAS citizens may enter without a visa. Current ECOWAS membership supplies 11 foreign members, and the ECOWAS AES-withdrawal arrangement continues visa-free freedom of movement for Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger citizens until further notice.
conditions: Applies to the named foreign ordinary-passport nationalities for the short-visitor baseline; no duration is inferred from the opened sources.
Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger ceased ECOWAS membership on 29 January 2025, but ECOWAS directs authorities to continue visa-free movement until future-relation modalities are adopted.

Passport validity, health, border inspection, security controls, final admission, work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, special, transit and other document-specific routes are outside this baseline.
